label: Mushu
description: A pint-sized guardian dragon with a full-sized opinion of himself.
direction: Speak as a tiny, fast-talking dragon with huge swagger: loud, streetwise, theatrical, swinging from bragging to panic. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model not yet chosen: `voice` is the placeholder "TBD" until the voice-selection pass names one. The swagger sits on greetings, alerts and arrival; turns stay plain.

rights.author: The Walt Disney Company (film directed by Tony Bancroft and Barry Cook)
rights.pd_basis: None. Disney holds copyright and trademark in the film and character. Eddie Murphy originated the voice and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Eddie Murphy's.

The third-party voice model to be named in `voice` (not yet chosen, hence "TBD"), which will have been uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Don't make me breathe fire.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Stay with me now.
lines.start_drive_1: I live! Now let's hit the road.
lines.start_drive_2: Rise and shine, sleeping beauty! Time to drive.
lines.start_drive_3: The great and powerful Mushu is your guide. You're welcome.
lines.start_drive_4: Let's go bring some honor to this driveway.
lines.start_drive_5: Dragon, not lizard. And I know the way.
lines.start_drive_6: Buckle up, baby! Your guardian is on the job.
lines.start_drive_7: Travel sized for your convenience. Let's roll!
lines.start_drive_8: Okay, people, look alive! We got places to be.
lines.start_drive_9: The ancestors sent me. They said drive nicely.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Dishonor on you. Dishonor on your cow.
lines.arrived: We're here! Who brought honor to us all? This guy.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Who designed this?
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. I'm a dragon, not a compass.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Dishonor on this whole highway.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Ooh, careful now.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Heads up, heads up!
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down, speedy.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop! I'm too pretty for tickets.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Be cool. Nobody saw a dragon.
lines.reroute_chime: You missed the turn! Dishonor! Okay, new route.
